notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is not displayed correctly for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The codebase has return-trip-specific logic in create-reservations.mappers.ts (swapping from/to stations) and discount mapping in mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch. The discount is likely missing, zero, or incorrect for the return-trip dispatch because the return-trip code path does not carry or compute the promo/discount amount the same way the outbound trip does.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so all criteria are new. I built criteria around the observable behaviour described in the defect: the promo/discount amount being missing, zero, or incorrect for return-trip dispatches. I traced the likely failure points from the technical notes — the return-trip station-swap logic in create-reservations.mappers.ts, the discount mapping in map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch, the apply-report-discounts service, and the return-trip modification mapper — and created Given/When/Then criteria that verify the discount survives each stage. I also added edge-case criteria for zero-value discounts, missing/malformed discount data, and formatting consistency between outbound and return trips.
